'''Boral Amadia''' was one of three powerful nobles who seized control of [[Tanchico]] during the [[War of the Hundred Years]] and founded the kingdom of [[Tarabon]] around it. 

==History==
He was a provincial governor and general under [[Artur Hawkwing]]. He died in the struggle for the city, leaving his compatriots Lady [[Tazenia Nerenhald]] and Lord [[Haren Maseed]] to become the first Queen and [[Panarch]], respectively.
